views.name: problem_occurrence_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT name AS problem, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
FROM solution
GROUP BY name
views.description: total occurrences per problem across the specified steps

views.name: filtered_problems
views.body_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT poc.problem
FROM problem_occurrence_counts poc
JOIN model_score ms ON poc.problem = ms.name
views.description: joins problem occurrence counts with step/version score comparisons, applies occurrence threshold and score condition filters, outputs problem
